items.question: Have all previous EMS non conformances been rectified (CAT1)?
Have all previous improvement opportunities been addressed (CAT2)?
Are Contractor NCRs available for previously identified EMS audit findings?
Is there an Environmental Policy in place, approved and signed by the organisation's senior management?
Has the Contractors EMS Manual been approved?
Has there been any changes to EMS Manual and has it been documented?
Does Contractor have established Management Review process to evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of management system?
Are management review records retained, and a process to manage non-conformances and related corrective actions in place?
Does the Contractor maintain a compliance obligation register which details applicable obligations (legal, permit conditions, emission standards) to which the project need to comply?
Does the Contractor undertake periodic Compliance obligation audits/verification to check their adherence to conditions of approval?
Has environmental objectives been established for the project?
Are adequately detailed programs for achieving objectives documented?
Has the Contractors CESMP been approved?
Is the CESMP reviewed annually and updated where applicable?
Are documents and records required by NEOM Environment retained and available?
Does the Contractor have a valid Environmental Permit (MEWA) and Accord?
Has Contractor Monthly Environmental Reports submitted on time?
Are the reported quantities in the Monthly Environmental Report accurate?
Are all reported quantities supported by verifiable source documentation?
Is Competency Management Program developed and implemented?
Is there an environmental training scheduled that correlates with the training matrix?
Is there an environmental component in the Contractors induction?
Are work specific environmental training records available?
Are regular environmental tool box talks conducted?
Is a record of what was discussed during the tool box talk available on file?
Do all workers attend environmental tool box talks?
Are resources made available for the EMS to be maintained and continually improved?
Has a full-time Environmental Manager been appointed and approved by NEV?
Is sufficient number of monitoring equipment and equipment required for control measures provided to conduct scope work?
Is there approved Waste Management Plan and fully implemented?
Is there a copy of the waste (non-hazardous) company operating permit available on file?
Are Waste Transfer Notes (WTN’s) for non-hazardous waste on file?
Are WTN’s signed by representatives from both contractor and waste company?
Is the type and quantity of waste specified on the WTN?
Is a register of non-hazardous waste collections maintained?
Is a copy of the Hazardous Waste company permit available on file?
Are records of hazardous waste disposal available on file?
Does the waste management register correlate to WTN’s available on file for non-hazardous and hazardous waste?
Is there a copy of the wastewater/sewage service provider permit available on file?
Is a register of wastewater/sewage collections maintained?
Are Wastewater Transfer Notes (WTN’s) for wastewater/sewage on file?
Are WTN’s for wastewater/sewage signed by representatives from both sewage producer/sewage hauler?
Is the quantity of wastewater/sewage specified on the WTN?
Are records (register) of wastewater/sewage disposal available on file?
Does the wastewater/sewage disposal register correlate to WTNs available on file?
Is site construction water sourced from approved and legal sources?
Are records of the projects water consumption available?
Are water records verified against available documentation?
Are records of the projects diesel consumption available?
Are records of the projects petrol consumption available?
Are fuel records verified against available documentation?
Does the vehicle/equipment maintenance conducted at an approved maintenance workshop area?
Are vehicle / equipment maintenance records available?
Are spill prevention training & refuelling training records available?
Is there documentation detailing the Contractor daily & weekly environmental inspections (reports)?
Does the contractor have a dedicated environmental checklist?
Have records of the env inspections been communicated to Contractor CM / PM?
Is there evidence of timely closure of corrective and preventive actions raised during environmental inspections/ internal audits?
Does the contractor conduct internal environmental management system audit? Are evidence, such as audit report and findings available for review?
Does the Contractor have established process to monitor and manage dust emissions?
Are dust monitoring reports available (for daily/weekly)?
Are all monitoring results within project specified limits?
Is there a map of dust monitoring location available on file?
Is the dust meter/monitor calibration certificate available and up to date?
Does the Contractor have established process to monitor and manage noise emissions?
Are records of noise monitoring data available on file?
Are all noise monitoring results within project specified limits?
Is there a map of noise monitoring location available on file?
Is the noise meter/monitor calibration certificate available and up to date?
Is a register of environmental incidents maintained?
For each environmental incident, is there a notification report and an investigation report?
Have incidents been reported to NEOM Environment?
Are records available to verify that corrective / preventive actions have been implemented?
Does the Contractor have an Emergency Response Plan?
Does the Emergency Response Plan adequately address environmental emergencies?
Is there evidence of environmental emergency mock drills available on file?
